title: Sample merit scholarship
text: This scholarship supports high achieving undergraduate students who demonstrate leadership, community service and financial need. Recipients are selected by an independent committee based on academic record, a personal statement and two letters of recommendation.

title: Sample postgraduate award
text: The award covers tuition fees, a monthly living allowance and return airfare for outstanding candidates pursuing a one year master's degree. Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree and submit their application through the official online portal before the published deadline.
